'''Sic-Six''' were a six-[[eye]]d [[Sentience|intelligent]] [[species]] who, due to their unusual appearance, were easily mistaken for pests. One Sic-Six resided in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]] on [[Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EV" />
